decisions.reason: The existing message-140 MODIFY already records that the surrounding letterforms must adapt to the fixed approved Hero V geometry, with no stale attributes requiring removal.
The existing message-140 MODIFY fully captures that the approved Hero V must remain unchanged as the alignment and refinement reference.
The existing message-140 MODIFY already records that the accent must be adapted or repositioned to align with the fixed approved Hero V without altering it.
The second V already must derive without distortion from the exact approved Hero V geometry; the source decision does not establish a new or changed second-V rule.
Restoring and preserving the approved Hero V geometry does not change the deferred champagne-gold material treatment or its design sequence.
The source decision concerns geometric reference and alignment during wordmark refinement and does not modify the brand-expression attributes.
The shared terminal rule remains valid unchanged; the source clarifies geometric alignment ownership but does not revise the terminal gesture or its shared application.
The instruction to preserve the approved Hero V geometry does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
